comparison: Strongly outperforms optimistic negative momentum (12/15 vs 8/14) via ~12x minibatch noise variance reduction, while still trailing zero-momentum unified-v11 (16/16) on 16-layer skip-free MLP depth conditioning, 8x heteroscedastic scale-mass, and DDGAN sustained suffix.
conclusion: LLM Muon-style positive Nesterov momentum (beta1=0.85, 1 state/param + 5-step Quintic NS) achieves 12/15 graded PASS (3 numerical FAIL, 1 TIMEOUT on five_word_joint_smoke under GPU contention) on r4-occam-ablation-v1. Passes gaussian1d_smoke/stability, zero_tanh_smoke/rail_escape (mae=0.001127), ring16 (hq=0.9912), vector_unequal_mass/width (core_min_eig=0.7362/0.4093), img_bars4 (4/4 hq=1.0), grid100 (prec=0.9771, ctr=0.1432), both >500x Nash tasks (hq=0.9539/0.9429), and t3_iso_horizon_saddle_shift (hq=0.9766). Fails only grid100_mlp16 (prec=0.9241, ctr=0.4114), t3_iso_scale_mass_8x (core_min_eig=0.3181), and model_ddgan_gaussian_chain (despite ultra-sharp t1_q0_mean=0.0626, eig=[0.831, 1.11]).
